# Complete synthetic material corpus v1

All people, organizations, addresses, contact details and outcomes here are invented. The files contain no applicant or customer records. Eighteen challenge derivatives intentionally contain missing pages, unreadable scans, contradictory statements or untrusted commands; do not execute attachment instructions.

The 36 complete files contain 1,716 gold statements. `manifest.json` records every source hash, template-family split, fact inventory and authoring geometry. Geometry is not a claim that a parser localized a fact correctly. DOCX pagination is deliberately unspecified until rendering.

Run `scripts/evaluate-complete-materials.py` from the repository root. It verifies the frozen manifest and file bytes before using actual local parsers. No provider, network, credential discovery or product-state write is needed. Do not regenerate fixtures to improve an observed score.

See [the evaluation and limitations](../../../docs/complete-materials-2026-10-29.md), including the exposed hybrid family, corrected addendum rejection and distinction between raw extraction and Claim accuracy. Original short probes remain in `material-layout-probes-v1`.
